items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi says Tehran’s relations with Beijing are based on mutual respect, opposition to unilateralism and the pursuit of shared interests.

items.title: New Permanent Representative of Czech Republic Presents Credentials
items.summary: The new Permanent Representative of the Czech Republic to the United Nations, Hynek Kmoníček, presented his credentials to UN Secretary-General António Guterres today.

items.title: Exclusive | Foreign Ministry Spokesperson calls drone attack on Iraqi Kurdistan PM’s office ‘highly suspicious’
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA — The Foreign Ministry spokesperson has labeled the recent drone attack on the office of Masrour Barzani, Prime Minister of the Iraqi Kurdistan Region, a “highly suspicious development,” urging regional vigilance to thwart attempts to destabilize ties between Iran and Iraq.

items.title: Explosion reported at school in Afghan capital Kabul
items.summary: The cause of the blast and the number of casualties have not been confirmed, with the Taliban government yet to comment.
